metadata.description: Conquer the Crucible, Become Shogun Nioh 3 is the eagerly anticipated continuation of the dark samurai action RPG series Nioh. A deadly struggle unfolds amidst the devastation of an alternate Warring States period where bandits run rampant and yokai skulk about. Nioh 3 Digital Deluxe Edition includes the following content: - Nioh 3 base game - Nioh 3 season pass - Nioh 3 season pass bonus Chijiko Netsuke Charm (accessory) Digital Deluxe Edition bonus: - Infernal Weapons Set (14 types) - Kodama Netsuke Charm (accessory) Notes: - The season pass is a set including add-on DLC. The DLC include new stories, enemies, yokai, boss characters, and equipment. - The player must progress to certain points in game to make the season pass content available. - Please be aware that bonuses may become available for purchase or for free as add-on content for this title at a later date. - The details and release dates of content may change without notice. - The season pass bonus will be released on the same date as the base game. Add-on DLC 1 is set to become available by the end of September 2026, and add-on DLC 2 is set to become available by the end of February 2027. Please see the official site (https://teamninja-studio.com/nioh3/) for more details. - The standard edition of Nioh 3 is also being sold. Please confirm that you have selected the correct product before making your purchase. - The base game and season pass are included in this product. Please be careful not to make duplicate purchases. - Demo save data will be automatically carried over upon launching the full game. (The demo save data must be saved on the same device used to play the full game.) - If the full game is started even once and save data is created, you will no longer be able to play the demo. - The demo completion bonus Twin-Snake Helmet, which can be obtained upon completing the demo by February 15, 2026, can also be obtained as a guaranteed item drop upon defeating Jakotsu-baba in the full game by February 15, 2026. Starting February 16, 2026, the item will become a rare drop from Jakotsu-baba.
metadata.notes: Game will take 5-10mins before it opens Some loading screen will also take 5-10mins
